title: The Hard Protocol
author: Dominic Nakamura
blurb: Vesper Vane, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
